beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Quick scroll, then I'll start my day.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: You said that three hours ago.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip one: no phone for thirty minutes.
beats.title: 1. Phone stays away

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Let your brain wake up before your notifications do.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Thirty minutes? That should be illegal.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip two: water and daylight first.
beats.title: 2. Water + daylight

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Morning light tells your body it's daytime. Free energy.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip three: do your hardest task first.
beats.title: 3. Hardest task first

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: So no more two-hour scroll breakfast?
